01 The person behind the work

I help brands build, grow, and stand out online through creative design, web development, and digital strategy. I move between two worlds: the digital space and the wild outdoors, where creativity meets nature and every moment tells a story.

Creative thinking meets digital technology.

I’m Tonny Macksembo, a digital professional passionate about helping businesses build a stronger online presence.

My work combines website development, SEO and AEO optimization, blog writing, social media management, graphic design and content automation. As a safari guide and wildlife photographer, I also bring a first-hand eye for travel and nature brands.

I believe a strong digital presence involves more than having a website or posting on social media. It means creating useful experiences, communicating clearly, reaching the right audience and working efficiently.

I’m continuously learning, experimenting and building practical digital solutions for businesses and brands.

06 FAQ

Common questions.

What services do you offer?

Website development, SEO and AEO, blog writing, social media management, graphic design, workflow automation, wildlife photography, and safari guiding and consulting.

How do we get started?

Send a message through the form or WhatsApp describing your goals. We discuss them, agree on the deliverables, and I get to work.

Can you improve a website I already have?

Yes. I can improve an existing site’s structure, on-page SEO, speed and clarity, or build a new one if that suits your goals better.

What is AEO?

Answer Engine Optimization. It means structuring your content with clear questions and answers so search assistants and AI-powered search can find and use it.

Do you work with tourism and safari businesses?

Yes. I work as a safari guide and manage marketing for a safari company, so I understand both the travel side and the digital side.

How do I get a quote?

Tell me about your project through the contact form. I’ll reply with next steps and pricing based on the scope of the work.
